sections.text: إجراء:Equipment Inspection (I1 - ΔP=26 mm Aq for Pre-Filter & 38 Aq for Cubic Filter)

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
preformed when ΔP=26 
mm Aq for 
pre-filter & 38 Aq for Cubic Filter as indicated in the title block.

تحتوي هذه الوحدة على فلتر هواء مسبق، وفلتر هواء من النوع المكعب، وهواء طبقي 
نظافة الفاصل بالقصور الذاتي
The above components in the air intake are distribution as the following:

Strata air cleaner housing 2 sets, 
 each set contains:

Filter house -1 set:
 contain totally 144 Pre-filter and 144 cubic filters
 (72 filters on each side)
It is provided on the filter hose.

The blow-in door is installed to open automatically when the static pressure 
 within the inlet house rise. above 1176 Pa (120 mm Aq) approximately, 
 overcoming the doors own weight.

sections.text:
The 
 pre-filter element is washable type and can be used twice and must be replaced at differential 
 pressure 254.8 Pa (26 mmAq)

The cubic filters element is disposable type and can not be reused and the 
interval for exchange about 5-8 times as long as pre-filter and must be replaced at 
differential pressure 372.4 Pa (38 mmAq)
